title: KinetiCAD complete automated test inventory

provenance.scope: Fresh automated execution only, using local Node 25.4.0. Replit-configured Node 24 was not exercised. No browser or computer-use checks were performed by this capture.
provenance.verificationCredit: Codex automated checks and computer-use checks are separately documented verification work; this inventory records Codex automated checks only.
provenance.originalIdentity: KinetiCAD was created by Andrew Blumson and Kevin Blumson with Replit Agent. This fresh verification does not reattribute the original implementation or historical Replit evidence.
provenance.rawReporterReconstruction: rawReporterEvents preserves every parsed JSONL event in order. The original compact UTF-8 JSONL bytes are also retained in rawReporterJsonl; hash rawReporterJsonl as UTF-8 to reproduce rawReporterSha256.

summary.interpretation: 298 expanded node:test cases from 39 files. Loop-generated cases are individually counted once. Assertions, helper calls, solver steps, meshes and historical experiment scenarios are not additional tests. File durations include setup/teardown; individual test times and total wall time are distinct.

assertionInventoryMethod: AST-matched each runtime file and declaration line. assertionCalls contains explicit assert calls and calls to same-file helpers statically reaching assertions. Helper definitions are listed per file. This is a source audit, not dynamic assertion coverage or a count of executed assertions; sourceText is retained for loops, setup and imported function context. A test that relies only on a validation function not throwing is marked acceptanceWithoutExplicitAssertion.

files.oracle: Runs the standalone, guided axial actuator with capped equal-and-opposite forces. Compares measured velocity, acceleration, displacement, reaction, energy and travel cutoff with F/m, gravity, momentum and work references.
files.limitations: A simple guided bench: no general CAD motor ratings, contact impacts, friction, electrical model or finite-force Stewart control.

standaloneExperiments.scope: Six fixture documents, 50 valid parts: 48 single solids and two preserved legacy compounds (windmill rotor 5 solids; orrery ring 24).
standaloneExperiments.limitationsAndPrerequisites: Rebuilds exact native CAD and writes /tmp/kineticad-demo-descriptors.json for the physics verifiers. Includes fixture-specific geometry checks. --refresh-metadata only refreshes metadata; it is not a numerical rerun.

standaloneExperiments.scope: Six demo worlds; report-specific motor samples and every-step anchor/drift checks.
standaloneExperiments.limitationsAndPrerequisites: Requires actual CAD descriptors from the preceding command. Sampled angular-rate maxima are not all-step peaks; reports record cadence.

standaloneExperiments.scope: Three eight-material runs, eight force-scaling comparisons and eight timestep comparisons.
standaloneExperiments.limitationsAndPrerequisites: The run/comparison counts are nested experiment measurements, not 19 additional automated tests. Requires CAD descriptors.

standaloneExperiments.scope: 72 exact OCCT pair checks across two measured endpoint poses, plus lane-envelope bounds.
standaloneExperiments.limitationsAndPrerequisites: Reads the fixture and material force report; endpoint intersections and travel-corridor bounds have distinct scopes.

standaloneExperiments.scope: One original six-second equal-extension/heave trajectory, with final poses for 14 bodies.
standaloneExperiments.limitationsAndPrerequisites: Requires actual CAD descriptors. This original motion is symmetric heave; it is separate from six-axis pose control.

standaloneExperiments.scope: 182 exact OCCT pair checks: all 91 pairs at the initial pose and measured six-second final pose.
standaloneExperiments.limitationsAndPrerequisites: Uses the measured original-heave report. Endpoint checks alone do not prove continuous swept clearance.

standaloneExperiments.scope: 16 trajectories: 15 measured every fixed step and one partition-invariance case measured at batch endpoints.
standaloneExperiments.limitationsAndPrerequisites: Requires actual CAD descriptors. Ideal velocity-controlled joints; no finite-force load model. The report records separate tracking, closure and speed gates.

standaloneExperiments.scope: One bounded workspace certificate, 72 motion certificates, 64 corner samples and 10 exact-OCCT spot poses (91 pairs per pose).
standaloneExperiments.limitationsAndPrerequisites: Floating-point conservative subdivision, not formal interval arithmetic; finite exact OCCT spots do not inspect every continuous pose. Reads the controller report for actual measured poses. Omitting --occt skips exact intersections.
A simple guided axial bench with explicit force ratings; not general CAD actuator forces or finite-force Stewart.
Exact cuboids and Coulomb friction; compare with the documented integration-error bound, not exact continuum endpoint equality.

standaloneExperiments.scope: One previously downloaded STEP/STL pair, remeasured using actual CAD and triangle integration.
standaloneExperiments.limitationsAndPrerequisites: Default inputs are checked-in browser-edited-export.step/.stl. Optional positional STEP/STL paths select other saved files. This script reads bytes; it does not open or operate Chrome.

standaloneExperiments.scope: Three previously downloaded Boolean STEP files and one subtract STL file, plus explicit nested-result rejection.
standaloneExperiments.limitationsAndPrerequisites: Uses checked-in downloaded bytes. This is file-content analysis of historical browser outputs, not a fresh browser interaction.

freshRunReport.scope: Actual shipped worker and installed OCCT. Box faces are planar, so STL tessellation has only float32 coordinate roundoff; these STL tolerances do not apply to arbitrary curved surfaces. Files represent committed modeller geometry, excluding transient editor previews.

freshRunReport.scope: Final connected Boolean solids, uniform density, exact OCCT mass properties, and actual Comlink/Rapier rigid-body response. Input transforms are baked into mesh, COM and principal frame; the descriptor transform is identity. Contact, friction, force-limited motors, automatic mate remapping, arbitrary Boolean assemblies and browser rendering are not established by these tests.
